label: Report
description: A news report is a shorter story about events with immediate relevance, written from a detached perspective.

label: Live Update
description: A live update is a series of brief reports from journalists on the ground while news is happening.

label: Feature
description: A feature is a longer story about people or systems with long-term or widespread relevance, written from a reporter's perspective.

label: Profile
description: A profile is a story about individuals and their worldviews, written from a reporter's perspective.

label: Q&A
description: A Q&A is a transcription of a conversation between an interviewee and The Ubyssey, edited by our journalists for length and clarity, written from a reporter's perspective.

label: Review
description: A review is a story about art or culture, written from a critical perspective.

label: Game Analysis
description: A game analysis is a story about individual games, written from a reporter's perspective.

label: Commentary
description: A commentary is a story that takes a position on an event or topic relevant to a sport, and suggests a course of action — either in the future or the past — written from a reporter's perspective.

label: Analysis
description: An analysis is a perspective piece on a topic relevant to a sport, explaining the reasoning and mechanics behind that specific phenomenon, written from a reporter's perspective.

label: Essay
description: An opinion essay is an author's view on the news, written from their own perspective but based on reporting.

label: Column
description: A column is a story written by a columnist — an opinion journalist who makes abstract judgments about the news and the way the world should be.

label: Editorial
description: An editorial is an opinion essay by the Ubyssey Editorial Board, the body of the newspaper's staff who debates and decides positions on the news of the day.

label: Letter to the Editor
description: A letter to the editor is a 250-word response to stories published in The Ubyssey, written by readers.

label: Letter from the Editor
description: A letter from the editor is a message to readers from The Ubyssey's Senior Masthead.

label: Public Service Announcement
description: A public service announcement is a piece sharing public interest information with imminent relevance, such as extreme weather or threats to public safety.

label: Other
description: Editors must seek approval from the senior masthead before publishing an 'other' story type.
